unpublishConfirm.title: Back to draft?
unpublishConfirm.description: The link and all printed QR codes stop working until you publish the album again.

photos.title: {count, plural, =0 {No photos} one {# photo} other {# photos}}

upload.hint: or choose files – several at once are fine

import.title: From the cloud
import.description: Import photos from Google Photos or Google Drive.

photos.pendingNotice: {count, plural, one {# guest photo is} other {# guest photos are}} waiting for your approval.

empty.title: No photos yet
empty.description: Drop photos into the area above or import them from the cloud.

photos.caption: Caption

deleteConfirm.title: Delete photo?
deleteConfirm.description: The photo is permanently deleted together with its comments and reactions.

access.title: Access
access.description: Who can open the album via the link or QR code.
access.passwordHint: At least 6 characters. Share the password separately.
access.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
access.passwordWarning: Changing the password signs out everyone who has already opened the album.
access.expiresHint: After this date guests can no longer open the album. Leave empty for no expiry.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.description: May people download the original photos?
downloads.allowedHint: Guests can save photos in original quality.
downloads.protectionNote: Without downloads only reduced-size views are delivered, and right-click and dragging are blocked. Screenshots can’t be prevented technically.
downloads.watermarkHint: A discreet text is rendered into the views.

interaction.title: Interaction
interaction.reactionsHint: Guests can react with the theme’s emoji.
interaction.guestUploadsHint: Signed-in guests can submit photos. They only appear after you approve them.
interaction.guestLimitHint: Number of photos one person may submit.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.label: E-mail notifications
notifications.hint: For new comments, guest photos and reports.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Deleting removes the album, photos, comments and reactions permanently. Distributed QR codes lead nowhere.
danger.mismatch: The title you entered doesn’t match.

draft.title: Not published yet
draft.description: Publish the album so the link works. Until then only you and admins can see it.

rotate.title: Renew link
rotate.description: Creates a new link and QR code. The old link and any printed cards stop working afterwards.
rotate.button: Revoke link & create new QR code
rotate.confirmDescription: All links and QR codes distributed so far – including printed cards – stop working immediately. You’ll need to distribute the new code again.

photos.title: Guest photos
photos.description: These photos were submitted by guests and aren’t visible yet.

comments.title: Comments awaiting approval
comments.description: These comments become visible once you approve them.

block.title: Blocked users
block.description: Blocked people can’t comment, react or submit photos in this album.
block.confirmDescription: They can no longer interact in this album and their comments are hidden.

privacy.title: Counted in a privacy-friendly way
privacy.text: Views are counted without cookies, tracking or stored IP addresses – each person at most once per day.
